hints.content: The graph shows Sean's position as a function of time. The slope of the graph represents the speed at which he is moving. Let's use the graph to complete the sentences one by one.

Looking at the graph, we see that Sean's position stays constant at $\blue{d=20}\text{ km}$, between $9\text{ a.m.}$ and $5\text{ p.m.}$ This represents the time Sean spends at work.  Therefore, his workplace is located $\blue{20}\text{ km}$ from his home.

We can calculate the slope of the graph 
of Sean's position function between $\red{8}\text{ a.m.}$ and  $\red{9}\text{ a.m.}$

$\qquad \dfrac{\textrm{rise}}{\textrm{run}} = \dfrac{\blue{20}-\blue{0}\ \textrm{ [km]}}{ \red{9} -\red{8} \ \textrm{ [h]}} = \dfrac{20 \textrm{ [km]}}{1 \textrm{ [h]}} = \purple{20} \ \textrm{km}/\textrm{h}$

Sean's average speed was $\purple{20}\text{ km/h}$  on his drive to work.

We can also calculate Sean's speed during the traffic jam after work.

$\qquad \dfrac{\textrm{rise}}{\textrm{run}} = \dfrac{\blue{10}-\blue{0}\ \textrm{ [km]}}{ \red{19} -\red{17} \ \textrm{ [h]}} = \dfrac{10 \textrm{ [km]}}{2 \textrm{ [h]}} = \purple{5} \ \textrm{km}/\textrm{h}$

Sean's average speed was $\purple{5}\text{ km/h}$ while stuck in traffic on his way home.

The correct way to complete the sentences is as follows:

- Sean's workplace is located ${\green{20}}\text{ km}$ from his home.   
- Sean's speed when he was driving to work was ${\green{20}}\text{ km/h}$.  
- Sean's speed between $5\text{ p.m.}$ and $7\text{ p.m.}$ was 
${\green5}\text{ km/h}$.

question.content:
Today, Sean left home at $8\text{ a.m.}$, drove to work, and worked from $9\text{ a.m.}$ until $5\text{ p.m.}$ On the drive back home, Sean got stuck in slow-moving traffic for $2$ hours, then stopped to have dinner, and finally got home at $9\colon30\text{ p.m.}$ 

The graph below shows Sean's distance, $d$, from his home (in kilometers) as a function of the time, $t$ (in hours).

**Complete the sentences below based on the graph of the function.**

* Sean's workplace is located [[☃ input-number 1]]$\text{ km}$ from his home.   
* Sean's speed when he was driving to work was [[☃ input-number 2]]$\text{ km/h}$.  
* Sean's speed between $5\text{ p.m.}$ and $7\text{ p.m.}$ was 
[[☃ input-number 3]]$\text{ km/h}$.


[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: An XY coordinate plane a line plotted.  The horizontal x axis represents the time, in hours, and runs from 0 to 25 in intervals of 1.  The vertical y axis represents the distance, in kilometers, and runs from 0 to 25 in intervals of 1. The line runs horizontal from (0, 0) until (8,0), then increases until (9, 20), then plateaus until (17, 20), then decreases until (19, 10), then plateaus until (21, 10), decreases again until (21.5, 0), and then plateaus until (24, 0).  The line passes through the points (0, 0), (8, 0), (9, 20), (17, 20), (4, 20), (18, 15), (19, 10), (20, 10), and (21, 10).
